result.stdout:
Usage: convert [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Writes a sheet out to another spreadsheet format, to a file or to standard output.

Arguments:
  [0] <string>    Path to the workbook (.xlsx, .xlsb, .xls or .csv).

Options:
  -s, --sheet <string?>      Sheet to convert, by name or zero-based index. Defaults to the first. [Default: null]
  -o, --output <string?>     File to write to. Writes to standard output when omitted. [Default: null]
  -f, --format <string?>     Output format: xlsx, xlsb, xls or csv. Defaults to --output's extension, or csv when writing to standard output. [Default: null]
  -d, --delimiter <char?>    CSV field separator. Ignored for every other format. Defaults to a comma. [Default: null]
  --password <string?>       Password for an encrypted .xlsx/.xlsb source workbook. [Default: null]

Usage: schema [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Prints the inferred column schema, as "index[TAB]name[TAB]type", with a trailing ? for nullable columns.

Arguments:
  [0] <string>    Path to the workbook (.xlsx, .xlsb, .xls or .csv).

Options:
  -s, --sheet <string?>    Sheet to inspect, by name or zero-based index. Defaults to the first. [Default: null]
  --header-row <int>       1-based row to take column names from; 0 means the sheet has no header. [Default: 1]
  --sample-size <int>      How many rows after the header to sample. [Default: 100]
  --password <string?>     Password for an encrypted .xlsx/.xlsb workbook. [Default: null]
